20ms 一拍(cfg::time::io::kTickMs); 每拍先 samplePower(); up.baro=false 时只采样电源不读气压; 读成功 -> healthSet(baro)+publish baroSnap; 失败且 healthClear 真翻边沿 -> 抛异常只报一次; 不打印任何东西
EXTI(rangeSem) 唤醒 + 100ms 兜底(cfg::time::range::kFallbackMs); up.range=false 直接跳过; NewData -> healthSet(range)+publish; NotReady/Invalid 不动健康位不报异常; Failed 且 healthClear 边沿 -> 抛异常; 兜底超时保证丢边沿也能退回轮询自愈
10ms 一拍(cfg::time::flow::kPeriodMs); up.flow=false 时每轮 probeFlow() 持续探测(自愈+给逻辑分析仪稳定波形); 读成功 -> healthSet(flow)+publish 并刷新 lastOkMs; 失败且 err!=FLOW_LOW_QUALITY 且 healthClear 边沿 -> 异常; 故意零打印
1Hz 限流(kFlowProbePeriodMs)重跑 flow.init() 做热插拔自愈; 成功置 up.flow=true 并打印; 前 3 次失败打判定表; flowProbes==1 时抛一次 FLOW_NOT_FOUND

100ms 一拍(cfg::time::gnss::kPeriodMs); 轮询 gnssRx.writePos() 并把新字节逐字 gnss.feed(处理跨回绕); overruns 变化 -> GNSS_UART_OVERRUN; sol.seq 变了才 publish; posValid 边沿 -> healthSet/Clear(gnss) 并只报一次 GNSS_NO_FIX; takeError -> 异常
